questions.prompt_md: Text: *Remote work has become common in many offices. Employees save time on commuting, but some say they feel isolated. Companies are now organising one team day per week.* — What is the text mainly about?

choices.text: Advantages, a disadvantage and a response related to remote work
How to organise a team day

questions.explanation_md: Recoge las tres partes: ventaja (tiempo), problema (aislamiento) y reacción de las empresas.

questions.prompt_md: Same text. True, False or Not mentioned: *All employees feel isolated when they work from home.*
questions.explanation_md: El texto dice *some*, no *all*: la opción exagera y contradice el texto.

questions.prompt_md: Same text. True, False or Not mentioned: *Remote workers are more productive than office workers.*
questions.explanation_md: La productividad no aparece en el texto. Suena razonable, pero no hay línea que lo justifique.

questions.prompt_md: Text: *The library opened a study room in 2021. It is open until midnight, and students can book it online.* — What does *it* refer to in the second sentence?
questions.explanation_md: Lo que se reserva en línea y abre hasta medianoche es la sala de estudio, el sustantivo más cercano y coherente.
